features.name: Palm Beach Zoo and Conservation Society
features.description: Palm Beach Zoo and Conservation Society is Dreher Park's 23-acre ticketed zoo, with shaded tropical paths, hundreds of animals, family amenities, dining, and separately reserved animal experiences.

features.name: Cox Science Center and Aquarium
features.description: Cox Science Center and Aquarium is Dreher Park's ticketed science museum and aquarium, with hands-on exhibits, aquarium programs, planetarium and observatory experiences, outdoor science areas, and sensory-access resources.
